request.style: English, soul, male deep voice with gospel choir, organ, piano, drums, bass, warm, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nehemiah called the people to the gate
Eliashib and priests began the work
Sheep Gate doors were set in their place
The wall rose up for every single soul

[Verse]
Joiada and Meshullam repaired the Old Gate
Beams were laid and bolts were made fast
Next to them Melatiah of Gibeon stood
And Jadon from Meronot helped them build

[Chorus]
Men of Gibeon and Mizpah joined the line
Under the governor beyond the river
Shoulders to the work, hands on the stone
We raised the wall and closed the gap

[Verse]
Sanballat and Tobiah were furious
They conspired to fight against Jerusalem
But we prayed to our God day and night
And posted a guard against their threat

[Chorus]
Men of Gibeon and Mizpah joined the line
Under the governor beyond the river
Shoulders to the work, hands on the stone
We raised the wall and closed the gap

[Chorus]
Men of Gibeon and Mizpah joined the line
Under the governor beyond the river
Shoulders to the work, hands on the stone
We raised the wall and closed the gap

[Bridge]
The laborers said the strength was failing
Too much rubble to carry on our backs
But the Jews lived near them and warned us
Turn around and they will come and kill

[Outro]
Finished in fifty-two days by God
The nations saw and their confidence sank
